zh.title: 通用原子公開Wildfire無人機 爭取美國空軍後繼機標案
zh.summary: 通用原子公開Wildfire無人機，競爭美國空軍低成本死神後繼機標案。
body: 通用原子航空系統（GA-ASI）於2026年9月10日公開了名為「Wildfire」的全新設計無人機。該公司已向美國空軍（USAF）與國防創新單位（DIU）合作進行的「大量模組化飛機」（MMA）競標提案，將其作為MQ-9A「死神」無人機的低成本且可容忍損耗的後繼機型。
根據競標規範，此項目要求無人機有效載重達1,270公斤以上，且單程轉場航程需達至少14,800公里。GA-ASI聲稱Wildfire符合或超越所有要求，不僅轉場航程超過該標準，還可同時搭載2枚遠程反艦飛彈（LRASM）或4枚聯合打擊飛彈（JSM），並由政府提供的自主軟體進行協同控制。

en.title: General Atomics Unveils Wildfire Drone as Lower-Cost successor to MQ-9 Reaper
en.summary: General Atomics has unveiled the Wildfire uncrewed aircraft to compete for the US Air Force's drone contract.
body: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems (GA-ASI) unveiled its new Wildfire uncrewed aircraft on September 10, 2026. The company has proposed the design for the Massed Modular Aircraft (MMA) competition, which is run by the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) and the US Air Force (USAF). It is positioned as a lower-cost, loss-tolerant alternative to the MQ-9A Reaper.

The MMA program seeks an aircraft with a payload of at least 1,270 kilograms (2,800 pounds) and a self-deployment range of at least 14,800 kilometers (8,000 nautical miles). GA-ASI claims Wildfire meets or exceeds these targets, offering a ferry range beyond 14,800 kilometers and the ability to carry heavy munitions like the Long Range Anti-Ship Missile.

zh.title: Joby於德州展開eIPP首飛
zh.summary: Joby於德州展開eIPP首飛；計劃測試往返達拉斯沃斯堡國際機場
body: Joby Aviation已於德州展開為期一週的示範活動，並啟動其首批電動垂直起降（eVTOL）整合試點計畫（eIPP）飛行。該開發商於2026年9月10日在沃斯堡聯盟機場（AFW）進行了德州首場eIPP飛行示範。此次飛行是在德州交通部「Nexus專案」提案下進行。
於2026年9月12日，Joby計畫進行一趟往返AFW與達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場（DFW）的飛行，並將進入管制空域以測試主要機場之間的飛行運作。美國交通部於2026年3月推出了eIPP計畫，旨在測試先進空中交通載具的實際應用。

en.title: Joby Aviation Commences First eIPP eVTOL Demonstration Flights in Texas
en.summary: Joby Aviation launches its first eIPP flights in Texas; plans demonstration to Dallas Fort Worth Airport
body: Joby Aviation has commenced its first eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) flights as part of a week-long demonstration campaign in Texas. On September 10, 2026, the developer performed its first eIPP flight at Perot Field Fort Worth Alliance Airport (AFW). This demonstration forms part of the Texas Department of Transportation's Project Nexus proposal.

On September 12, 2026, Joby plans to perform a roundtrip flight from AFW to Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW). The aircraft will enter controlled airspace to test flight operations between major airports. The eIPP program was originally launched by the US Department of Transportation in March 2026 to evaluate advanced air mobility applications.

zh.title: 阿聯酋航空空中巴士A380豪華經濟艙10月將登陸巴黎
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空宣佈自十月二十五日起在杜拜至巴黎航線部署改裝空中巴士A380客機
body: 阿聯酋航空（Emirates）宣佈將自2026年10月25日起，在杜拜往返巴黎的航線上啟用改裝後的空中巴士（Airbus）A380客機。此舉將首度為巴黎戴高樂機場（CDG）航線引進其全新的豪華經濟艙，並每日執飛EK071與EK072航班。
這項部署完成了該航空公司在法國三大門戶機場的豪華經濟艙佈局。先前，阿聯酋航空已在里昂機場（LYS）及尼斯機場（NCE）航線推出此項艙等服務。
根據歷史紀錄，阿聯酋航空工程部門先前已啟動一項數十億美元的投資計畫，全面改裝旗下219架空中巴士A380及波音777客機，這也為其在全球航網中持續推廣升級版客艙產品提供了支援。

en.title: Emirates to Deploy Retrofitted Airbus A380 with Premium Economy on Dubai-Paris Route
en.summary: Emirates will launch retrofitted Airbus A380 Premium Economy service to Paris starting October 25.
body: Emirates has announced that it will deploy its retrofitted Airbus A380 on the Dubai-Paris route starting October 25, 2026, introducing its Premium Economy cabin to Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG). The retrofitted aircraft will operate daily flights EK071 and EK072.
This development completes the airline's rollout of Premium Economy across all three of its French gateways, which also include Lyon-Saint-Exupéry Airport (LYS) and Nice Côte d'Azur Airport (NCE).

According to historical records, Emirates Engineering previously initiated a multi-billion-dollar investment program to fully refurbish 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft, which supports the ongoing rollout of these upgraded cabin products across its global network.

zh.title: 維珍航空將兩架波音787-9客機出售予波蘭航空
zh.summary: 維珍航空計劃縮減波音787機隊，並將其中兩架客機於2027年移交予波蘭航空。
body: 根據航空媒體Simple Flying報導，英國維珍航空（Virgin Atlantic）已採取行動縮減其波音（Boeing）787 Dreamliner機隊。該航空公司已同意將旗下兩架波音787-9客機出售予波蘭航空（LOT Polish Airlines），目前正計劃將其波音787機隊總數從17架減少至14架。
波蘭航空執行長Michał Fijoł已證實，這兩架客機的移交工作預計將於2027年完成。此一舉措將擴大波蘭航空現有的Dreamliner機隊，該機隊目前已包含八架波音787-8與七架波音787-9客機。

en.title: Virgin Atlantic Sells Two Boeing 787-9s to LOT Polish Airlines
en.summary: Virgin Atlantic will sell two Boeing 787-9s to LOT Polish Airlines with completion in 2027.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, UK carrier Virgin Atlantic has taken the next step in reducing its Dreamliner fleet. The airline has agreed to hand over two of its Boeing 787-9 aircraft to LOT Polish Airlines as it works to bring its total Boeing 787 fleet down from 17 to 14 jets.

LOT Polish Airlines' chief executive, Michał Fijoł, has confirmed that the aircraft transfer is scheduled to be completed in 2027. The move will grow LOT's pre-existing Dreamliner fleet, which already includes eight Boeing 787-8s and seven Boeing 787-9s.

zh.title: 阿爾及利亞宣布對阿拉伯聯合大公國註冊飛機關閉領空
zh.summary: 阿爾及利亞宣布對阿聯註冊飛機關閉領空；但排除飛往阿爾及爾的民航航班
body: 阿爾及利亞宣布，自2026年9月11日午夜起，向所有在阿拉伯聯合大公國（阿聯）註冊的民用與軍用飛機關閉其領空。此項決定是在阿爾及利亞國防部於9月10日宣布，且該國決定與阿聯中斷外交關係後做出的。
根據該國國防部，此項禁令將豁免往返阿爾及爾 Houari Boumediene 國際機場的阿聯商用民用航班，該豁免將持續至2026年底合約到期為止。
此外，阿爾及利亞曾在2026年2月通知阿聯民航總局，將終止兩國於2013年簽署的航空服務協定。儘管阿聯酋航空曾計劃營運至2027年2月，但 FlightAware 數據顯示其最後一班往返杜拜與阿爾及爾的航班已於2026年3月執行。

en.title: Algeria closes airspace to UAE-registered civilian and military aircraft
en.summary: Algeria closes its airspace to United Arab Emirates registered aircraft starting September 11
body: Algeria has closed its airspace to all civilian and military aircraft registered in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) starting midnight on September 11, 2026. The move follows the Algerian government's decision on September 10, 2026, to sever diplomatic relations with the UAE.

According to the Algerian Ministry of Defense, the airspace closure exempts commercial civilian UAE flights arriving at and departing from Houari Boumediene International Airport in Algiers. This exemption will remain in effect until the expiration of the current contract at the end of 2026.

Previously, in February 2026, Algeria notified the UAE's General Civil Aviation Authority that it would terminate the 2013 air services agreement. FlightAware data indicates that the last Emirates flight between Dubai and Algiers occurred in March 2026, with no other UAE airlines currently operating flights to Algeria.

zh.title: 加拿大成立國防無人機採購平台 首批選定四款無人航空系統
zh.summary: 加拿大宣布成立無人機採購平台並選定首批系統，同時加強與烏克蘭國防合作。
body: 加拿大總理卡尼（Mark Carney）於2026年9月10日在卡加利與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）一同宣布，加拿大已正式成立「國防無人機倡議市場」（Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace，簡稱 DDIM）採購平台。該機制旨在為加拿大武裝部隊及海岸警衛隊迅速採購各類無人機系統，標誌著加拿大在擴充無人機戰力方面邁出重要一步。
根據報導，這項採購機制為2026年7月23日啟動的國防無人機倡議之執行工具，模式參考了烏克蘭的 Brave1 國防科技聚落。加拿大總理辦公室表示，已有近400家供應商取得該平台的資格認證。加拿大政府計畫在首批合約中投入高達5000萬加元（約3600萬美元），預計將使加拿大武裝部隊的無人機庫存大幅增加十倍。

在首批擬議採購的裝備中，包含四款無人航空系統與兩款無人地面載具。四款無人航空系統分別為 AVSS Drone D1、Volatus Aerospace Huntsman X6、Draganfly Astiia 以及 Objexis AI MAQ-C。此外，兩款無人地面載具則為 Twenty20 Insight XRC RHINO 與 Beonyx VTSE-TC。官方說明文件指出，這些系統包含加拿大本地與國際合作設計，例如 Huntsman X6 與 XRC RHINO 係在英國生產並獲得加拿大支援，Astiia 則基於澳洲技術並授權在加拿大製造。
除了國內採購措施外，卡尼與澤倫斯基亦簽署了《關於加強國防與安全合作的聯合宣言》，涵蓋國防裝備的共同開發與聯合生產。雙方合作建立在2025年8月24日於基輔簽署的合作意向書基礎之上。此外，奇異動力任務系統加拿大分公司（General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada）將與烏克蘭 Green Tech Harvest 公司合作，共同開發與生產無人機及相關技術。
此外，加拿大亦承諾透過「烏克蘭聯合多國計畫：服務、訓練與物件快速時間表」（JUMPSTART）機制，提供約3.5億加元（約2.53億美元）資金用於採購防空攔截飛彈。此項由美國主導的機制旨在運用盟國捐款為烏克蘭籌措軍事裝備，進一步深化兩國在防務領域的合作關係。

en.title: Canada Establishes Defence Drone Marketplace and Selects Initial Systems
en.summary: Canada established a defense drone marketplace, selecting four uncrewed aircraft systems and expanding cooperation with Ukraine.
body: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced in Calgary on September 10, 2026, alongside Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, that Canada has established a new national defense drone procurement portal named the Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace (DDIM). The supply arrangement serves as the primary procurement vehicle for the Defence Drone Initiative launched on July 23, 2026, aiming to acquire uncrewed systems for the Canadian Armed Forces and the Canadian Coast Guard.

According to the Prime Minister’s Office, nearly 400 suppliers have qualified for the marketplace, which Ottawa modeled after Brave1, Ukraine’s defense technology cluster. Initial contract awards under the initiative could reach up to C$50 million ($36 million), an investment expected to expand the Canadian Armed Forces' drone inventory tenfold, although the current size of the inventory was not disclosed.

The initial procurement batch selected by Canada features four uncrewed aircraft systems: the AVSS Drone D1, Volatus Aerospace Huntsman X6, Draganfly Astiia, and Objexis AI MAQ-C. In addition, two uncrewed ground vehicles were selected, including the Twenty20 Insight XRC RHINO and Beonyx VTSE-TC. Government background documents indicate that these models include both local and international manufacturing arrangements, with the Huntsman X6 and XRC RHINO produced in the United Kingdom with Canadian support, and the Astiia manufactured in Canada under license based on Australian technology.

In tandem with the procurement announcement, Carney and Zelenskyy signed a Joint Declaration on Enhancement of the Defence and Security Cooperation to foster co-development and co-production of military equipment. Building on a letter of intent signed in Kyiv on August 24, 2025, the bilateral framework establishes deeper ties between defense contractors in both nations. As part of this cooperation, General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada will partner with Ukrainian firm Green Tech Harvest to develop and produce drones and associated technologies.

Furthermore, Canada committed approximately C$350 million ($253 million) for air defense interceptors through the US-led Joint Ukraine Multinational Program: Services, Training and Articles Rapid Timeline (JUMPSTART). The mechanism uses allied contributions to procure defense materiel for Ukraine, further bolstering international military assistance efforts.
